Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You have watched every feint. When they finally run, your shot is already waiting.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
Knowledge
Target / range / shape
A visible creature within 8 squares after it moves voluntarily.
Duration
Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.
Equipment / acquisition
Gain one ordinary ranged weapon and one d8 ammunition bundle if absent; each Bulk 1. Check ammunition after every attack.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

Take the shot you were waiting for. Requires ranged weapon and ammunition; check supply. This attack cannot trigger additional free attacks.

Weak
4 physical damage.
Standard
4 physical damage and Slowed 1.
Strong
6 physical damage and knock prone.
